title: Question-Based Design (QBD) v0
questions: What problem are we solving and for whom?
What are the primary user journeys?
What is explicitly out of scope?
What are the core domain concepts and their relationships?
What data do we store and what are the sources of truth?
What are the key user permissions or roles?
What are the critical workflows and their inputs/outputs?
What are the main failure modes and how do we handle them?
What are the performance and scalability constraints?
What are the security and privacy requirements?
What external systems or integrations are required?
What is the MVP slice and what can be deferred?
What are the testable acceptance criteria?
What are the operational concerns (logging, metrics, backups)?
What are the open questions or risks?
